{{Quote|You've come to work for the Lady Hutt, have you? Smart to sign on to the winning team. How about we start you off with something simple? I need a courier to go pick up this week's drop. Interested?|Karena Keer to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Karena Keer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She worked for [[Shalera]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] member of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Karena Keer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
